title.zh: Zero Lock（全零 code hash，不是合约）
title.en: Zero Lock (all-zero code hash, not a contract)

subtitle.zh: 来源：CKB 节点 nervosnetwork/ckb script/src/types.rs（TxData::extract_script）　·　code_hash 0x00…00，hash_type data（主网与测试网相同，CKB Explorer 注册表）
subtitle.en: Source: CKB node nervosnetwork/ckb script/src/types.rs (TxData::extract_script)　·　code_hash 0x00…00, hash_type data (same on mainnet and testnet, CKB Explorer registry)

title.zh: 创建：任何人都能把 cell 锁进 Zero Lock
title.en: Create: anyone can put a cell under the Zero Lock

body.zh: Cell{ lock: 任意（由其自身 lock 授权） }
body.en: Cell{ lock: any (authorised by its own lock) }

outputs.label: output

extras.zh: lock 只在 input 中执行，所以创建时不运行任何 Zero Lock 代码，也没有检查。
extras.en: Locks only run for inputs, so no Zero Lock code runs and nothing is checked when it is created.

cond.zh: hash_type 为 data/data1/data2 时，节点在 cell_deps 中找 blake2b(data) = code_hash 的 cell；没有任何数据的 hash 是全零，找不到
cond.en: for hash_type data/data1/data2 the node looks in cell_deps for a cell with blake2b(data) = code_hash; no data hashes to all zeros, so none is found

notes.zh: 这不是“未开源合约”：链上不存在对应代码，行为完全由 CKB 节点的脚本解析规则决定，因此单独标注。
notes.en: This is not a closed-source contract: no code exists on chain; its behaviour is defined entirely by the CKB node's script resolution, so it is listed separately.

notes.zh: 用途：常用作“销毁 / 永久锁定”的输出 lock（例如 UTXOSwap 文档里 LP Token Info cell 的 lock 是 all zero）。CKB Explorer 注册表在 2026-11-06 显示主网有约 84.03 亿 CKB 位于该 lock 下。
notes.en: Use: a common burn / lock-forever output lock (e.g. the UTXOSwap docs give the LP Token Info cell an all-zero lock). On 2026-11-06 the CKB Explorer registry showed about 8.403 billion CKB under this lock on mainnet.

notes.zh: 没有可花费的测试交易：只出现在 output 中，解码器只给 input 中的 lock 建组。
notes.en: No spending test tx exists: it only ever appears in outputs, and the decoder only groups locks found in inputs.
